system.description:
When this spell is cast, all friendly creatures in the area of effect gain a +1 bonus to attack, damage, and morale rolls for the duration, provided they are not already engaged in combat.

Reverse: Blight gives each enemy in the area a –1 penalty to attack, damage and morale rolls for the duration provided they are not already in combat. Each of these enemies may make a spell save to avoid the effect.
